verdict.rationale: Shopify's own docs say Tap to Pay turns a smartphone into a checkout. It accepts contactless credit and debit cards, smartwatches and digital wallets over WiFi or cellular, which delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that no separate card reader is needed, documented device and region compatibility requirements, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept contactless card payments on an off-the-shelf phone (Tap to Pay) without buying a reader

citations.quote: Turn your smartphone into a checkout for on-the-go selling with Tap to Pay.
Tap to Pay works with contactless credit and debit cards, smartwatches, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and digital wallets for fast and smooth checkouts.
WiFi and cellular data connectivity let you take contactless payments, look up customer profiles, or view inventory with a smartphone on the sales floor.
